notes: Piece counts match the parts list: 212 pieces over 55 lines.

Fixed the 'resting on a tile' errors. The two Rialto arches (b75, b76) now rest on studded pieces only (b34/b3 and b40/b5). The white side bricks and plates in the Basilica front (b111, b112, b121, b122, b125, b126) rest on the studded 3034 plate b8 and the 92593 plates b49/b50 instead of the groove tiles b46-b48.

The booklet shows the models only in isometric views, so many rests_on lists are best estimates of which pieces sit under each part. Some are rough: the left-end base tiles, the central block of plates, and the church wall layers.
Steps 20-22 (black tiles and the Venice tile) are fronted onto the side studs of the 87609 plates, so they have empty rests_on and an other_join instead.
Sub-assemblies on pages 71-82 and 84-90 (domes, central tower, campanile) are built separately and then placed on the base. Their ids follow booklet order.
Technic holes on the 32000 bricks take the tooth plates sideways. Two copies of the window sub-assembly are built (step 46).
The 62361 arches have studs on top in the booklet, but the catalogue lists only anti-studs, so cones and Technic bricks are recorded as resting on them.

The bars (87994) and open-stud round plates (85861) form the two column shafts. Each column is a round plate on a jumper stud, a bar in its open stud, another round plate on the bar, then the clip tile or the trophy.
Positions are left null as requested.
